review_status: Same-agent proof audits; independent specialist review outstanding.
novelty_status: Unverified for every candidate; no established novel result.

entries.result: Explicit index-two subgroup isomorphism in F2 with no nontrivial forward-invariant subgroup, even without finite generation or normality.
entries.prior_scope: Nearby virtual-endomorphism and invariant-subgroup results are credited in the audit; novelty is unverified.
entries.limits: Lean verifies the matrix argument, not the full free-group theorem.

entries.result: Uniform direct-decomposition decision and factor construction for finite presentations promised to define finitely generated nilpotent groups, including torsion.
entries.prior_scope: Torsion-free decision and rational decomposition machinery are prior. Potentially new scope is the general torsion case.
entries.limits: The promise is essential. The finite-presentation pipeline is implemented only through class two; higher-class integration remains unimplemented.

entries.result: A primitive-preserving endomorphism of a free metabelian group of any finite rank is an automorphism.
entries.prior_scope: Ranks at most two are prior; Bachmuth's inverse-function criterion and the Fox/Magnus machinery are credited.
entries.limits: The effective finite-field witness bound is not a practical complexity bound. The integral-flow supplement reproves a credited classical ingredient.

entries.result: No uniform polynomial-time conversion from arbitrary finite hyperbolic-group presentations to explicit finite Dehn presentations, even with new generators and infinite non-elementary virtually free inputs.
entries.prior_scope: Classical Dehn-language bounds and related earlier output-size obstructions are credited.
entries.limits: Ordinary explicit word output and torsion-allowing input are essential; no compressed-output or torsion-free lower bound is claimed.

entries.result: Every nontrivial nonprimitive word in rank r at least two has automorphic-orbit ball growth rate sqrt(2r-1), and the same spherical limsup.
entries.prior_scope: Prior special cases and the full Kharlampovich-Myasnikov multipattern theorem and Pillay genericity theorem are credited.
entries.limits: Identity and rank one require separate conventions. No spherical limit or stronger word-dependent cyclic-orbit rate is asserted. Constants depend on the fixed word.

entries.result: Free-square discrimination for every nonabelian group acting freely without inversions on an arbitrary ordered-abelian-group tree; arbitrary generation is allowed.
entries.prior_scope: The literal nontrivial abelian case is negative and is not counted separately. Related discrimination results and the imported general tree-collapse theorem are credited.
entries.limits: The positive theorem requires nonabelianness. Free-group computations do not validate the general collapse; the elementary separator remains a written argument.

entries.result: Uniform decision of potential positivity in all finite ranks, together with the credited prior negative answer to the stability question in (b).
entries.prior_scope: Rank-two decision in (a) and the answer to (b) are prior; potentially new scope is higher-rank (a).
entries.limits: Full EDT0L solution-relation construction is imported and unimplemented. Shared linear-span formalization does not formalize the entire algorithm. Identity convention is explicit.

entries.result: Uniform decisions of translation equivalence (a) and bounded translation equivalence (c) in every finite rank; (b) is credited prior.
entries.prior_scope: Part (b) and the rank-two decisions are prior. The proposed new scope is higher-rank (a) and (c).
entries.limits: Part (a) imports an unimplemented full EDT0L construction. Part (c)'s sufficiency imports graded shortening. The quantifier is over ambient automorphisms, with separate identity cases.

entries.result: Single commutator equations are decidable, with solution construction, in every finite-rank free nilpotent group of every finite class; general class-two undecidability in (a) is prior.
entries.prior_scope: Part (a) and the free class-two instance of (b) are prior. The current candidate has no class cutoff.
entries.limits: The complete all-rank/class solver is unimplemented. Formal analytic and polynomial ingredients leave the free-associative/Lie/group dictionary and full algorithm written.

entries.result: Undecidable retract problem in one fixed finitely generated torsion-free class-two group, on two-generator isolated Heisenberg subgroups with primitive images in both graded layers.
entries.prior_scope: The uniform class-wide version of (a) and the affirmative free-nilpotent answer to (b) are prior. Potentially new scope is the one fixed ambient group.
entries.limits: DPRM is imported; the universal numerical circuit and presentation are not expanded. Toy groups and Lean normalization are limited checks, not a full reduction verification.

entries.result: Computable standard growth constant with an explicit approximation modulus for every finite-rank free metabelian group; certified rank-two interval 2.658596558 to 2.943737759. Extension to free solvable groups.
entries.prior_scope: Flow models, bridge/unfolding arguments and earlier estimates are credited. The solvable extension is not another problem count.
entries.limits: The exact growth constant remains undetermined. Fine-precision computation is not demonstrated.

entries.result: Countably infinitely many special braids in each B_N for N at least five; deductions from prior structure give counts 1, 2 and 4 for N=1,2,3.
entries.prior_scope: Dehornoy's structure and right-power theorem are credited. Small-strand deductions and the known ten B4 braids are not separately counted.
entries.limits: B4 remains unresolved, specifically its exponent-two sector. At least ten special B4 braids are known; excluded families and parameter restrictions are not exhaustion.
